bindings.label: Woman in her 20s presented with well-demarcated hand dermatitis on the left and right third fingers
The dermatitis was recalcitrant and unresponsive to topical medications including corticosteroids
Medical history was remarkable for 'eczema' dating back to childhood; patch testing results were negative

Physical examination showed sharply demarcated erythematous scaly plaques with fissures, scale crust, and nail pitting on the left and right third fingers; the left third finger was confluently covered while the rest of the hand was unaffected
Skin biopsy shows intraepidermal neutrophil-rich spongiform pustules and nail bed acanthosis with spongiform pustules
Serum tryptase was elevated at 42 ng/mL and the bone marrow aspirate showed mast cell infiltration
